programs.title: QI
programs.desc: Bill Bailey, Dara O Briain, Phill Jupitus and Alan Davies discuss catastrophes, cosmonauts and coconuts. Stephen Fry hosts.

programs.title: Would I Lie To You?
programs.sub_title: Kevin Bishop, Brian Blessed, Josh Widdicombe And Kate Williams
programs.desc: The award-winning comedy panel show, hosted by Rob Brydon, features team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell joined by a lively guest line-up. Actor and comedian Kevin Bishop, legendary actor Brian Blessed OBE, stand-up star Josh Widdicombe, and historian Professor Kate Williams all take part, sharing tall tales, quick wit, and outrageous bluffs.

programs.title: Mythbusters
programs.desc: Can a ping pong ball inflict a lethal injury if it flies fast enough? Can a cannon and cannonballs made from ice be a reliable weapon?

programs.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent Specials
programs.desc: Phil's in Warrington, and Pauline and Alan Jacks want to downsize but have had no interest in their three bed property. Just a mile away, Colin Brunold is hoping his four bed family home will sell itself.

programs.title: Grand Designs UK
programs.desc: Mark and Candida Diacono set themselves an ambitious schedule of just seven months to build their house and barn. The house has a timber frame and timber cladding, and the barn, an all steel frame and traditional Devon cob.

programs.title: Claire Hooper's House Of Games
programs.desc: Hanging out in Claire Hooper's House of Games this week, we've got performer Eddie Perfect, swimmer Emily Seebohm, and comedians Alex Lee and Dave Thornton testing their wits for the chance to win a bread bin. Or a trophy.
